description: This Java class defines a configurable UI component for Android Dex compiler settings within an IDE, allowing users to modify compiler options such as heap size, VM options, and optimization flags.

classes.name: AndroidDexCompilerSettingsConfigurable
classes.description: A class implementing a configurable UI for Android Dex compiler settings, integrating with IDE options framework.

methods.name: AndroidDexCompilerSettingsConfigurable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the configuration UI components and linking them with project settings.

methods.description: Provides the help topic ID for context-sensitive help.
